references.text: Jesus gives similar instructions to the twelve disciples in Matthew: they are to find out who is worthy in a town and stay there until they move on. The same principle of staying in one house.
Mark's parallel account of the sending of the twelve, where Jesus says that when they enter a house, they should remain there until they leave the place.
Luke's account of the sending of the seventy(-two), where Jesus also instructs them to stay in the house they enter, eat and drink what is offered, and not move from house to house.
Lydia insists that Paul and his companions stay in her home after she was converted—an example of accepting hospitality and staying in one house, as Jesus instructed.
Jason welcomed Paul and Silas into his home in Thessalonica—an example of missionaries staying in a specific house during their stay in a city.
